milestone: T3 — first balanced SFT adapter (Qwen3-1.7B QLoRA)

adapter_promotion.note: checkpoint is kept as historical T3 evidence (training/adapters/sciencemath-v0.1-t3/) but is NOT promoted as a Mango candidate: math regressed materially while science was preserved, violating the balanced-checkpoint requirement

catastrophic_forgetting_gate.rule: science macro < 71.67% (5.0 pp below the declared 76.67% reference) triggers SCIENCE_REGRESSION

regression_analysis.science_preserved: general_science exactly matches the baseline (0.7667); the SFT science format ('Answer: \boxed{...}') transfers cleanly
regression_analysis.math_collapsed: every math category fell 12.5-30 pp. Mechanism (from failure analysis): the adapter was trained toward concise targets (avg output 172 tokens vs baseline 366); the base model's long chain-of-thought was doing real work on multi-step competition math, and the concise SFT style removed it. 16/188 outputs truncated at 1024 tokens; 12 extraction failures (rambling or [asy] diagram echo without reaching a boxed answer); uncertainty_calibration collapsed to 0 (model now confidently fabricates answers instead of admitting undeterminability)
regression_analysis.instruction_following_improved: 0.7 -> 1.0 (the model follows the boxed-answer instruction format more reliably)
regression_analysis.ablation: genuine adapter effect proven: adapter on/off outputs differ on 4/4 checked questions, active states recorded programmatically
regression_analysis.metric_integrity: independent recomputation from predictions.jsonl via compute_metrics is IDENTICAL to saved metrics.json; suite verified before evaluation (188/188, checksummed)

lessons_for_next_milestone: T4's deterministic verification/tools is now clearly the right lever for math: SFT alone on this corpus made math worse, not better
future math SFT targets must preserve full multi-step reasoning (or the model must recover it via tools), not terse summaries
uncertainty calibration needs explicit training coverage and eval protection
future adapters use Mango naming (mango-v0.x-*); this one is frozen historical evidence
